personal_information.title: Data-driven Customer Experience & Front-end Specialist
personal_information.summary: As a Data-driven Customer Experience & Front-end Specialist, I bridge analytics and implementation to create exceptional digital experiences. I transform user behavior data into actionable insights, then bring these insights to life through scalable, accessible front-end solutions. By combining data analysis, experimentation and modern web technologies, I consistently enhance conversion rates and customer satisfaction. My hands-on scope includes technical web analytics engineering (custom JavaScript tracking, data layer design, advanced SQL analysis, consent integrations), as well as building responsive interfaces with React, HTML/CSS and accessibility-first development. This dual expertise allows me to both identify opportunities through data and implement solutions directly through code.
personal_information.short_summary: Data-driven Customer Experience & Front-end specialist with 18+ years of experience across banking, telecom, e-commerce and digital platforms. I bridge analytics and implementation to create exceptional digital experiences. With expertise spanning technical web analytics engineering (custom JavaScript tracking, data layers, SQL analysis, consent integrations) and modern front-end development (React, HTML/CSS, accessibility-first), I transform user behavior data into actionable insights and scalable solutions. I have led analytics implementations in complex regulated environments while building responsive, accessible interfaces. My dual expertise allows me to both identify opportunities through data and implement solutions directly through code.
